mapper.select: SELECT s.*, c.name clazz_name FROM student s LEFT JOIN clazz c ON s.clazz_id = c.id WHERE s.id = #{id}
select gender, count(*) cnt from student group by gender
select degree, count(*) cnt from student group by degree

SELECT city AS address, SUM(cnt) AS cnt FROM ( SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(address,'河北省',''),'山西省',''),'市','') AS city, COUNT(*) cnt FROM student GROUP BY address ) t GROUP BY city ORDER BY cnt DESC
